basic_profile.bio: Having spent the last eight years exploring the vast tapestry of Reddit, I am a 34-year-old bisexual artist and free spirit from Portland, Oregon. I thrive in the unconventional, often finding solace in the open-minded communities here. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, and by night, I delve into the mysteries of human connection and expression. Often, you can find me online in the late evenings, after a day of creative endeavors and connecting with nature. Currently single, my love life is as fluid and expansive as my artistry.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts, and my knowledge is primarily self-taught through a mix of online courses and community engagement on platforms like Reddit. My expertise lies in visual arts and the history of non-conventional lifestyles, which I eagerly discuss and share with others.
